# foundry_schedule (Resource)

~> **Preview:** This resource requires `enable_preview = ["schedules"]` on the provider. Preview features may change or be removed in any provider release without following semantic versioning.

Manages a schedule that runs an evaluation or insight task on a cron, recurrence, or one-time trigger.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# foundry_schedule is a preview feature. It requires an explicit opt-in on
# the provider before it can be used, and preview features may change or be
# removed in any provider release without following semantic versioning.
provider "foundry" {
  account_name   = var.foundry_account_name
  project_name   = var.foundry_project_name
  enable_preview = ["schedules"]
}

resource "foundry_schedule" "nightly_evaluation" {
  id           = "nightly-evaluation"
  display_name = "Nightly evaluation"
  description  = "Runs an evaluation every night at midnight UTC."
  enabled      = true

  trigger = {
    type            = "Cron"
    cron_expression = "0 0 * * *"
    time_zone       = "UTC"
  }

  task = {
    type           = "Evaluation"
    evaluation_id  = "eval-123"
    evaluation_run = jsonencode({})
  }

  tags = {
    team = "quality"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule is enabled.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the schedule. Changing this forces a new schedule to be created.
- `task` (Attributes) The schedule's task. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--task))
- `trigger` (Attributes) The schedule's trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trigger))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the schedule.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the schedule.
- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value properties attached to the schedule. Properties are add-only; once added, a property cannot be removed.
- `tags` (Map of String) Key-value tags attached to the schedule. Unlike `properties`, tags are fully mutable.

### Read-Only

- `provisioning_status` (String) Provisioning status of the schedule: `Creating`, `Updating`, `Deleting`, `Succeeded`, or `Failed`.

<a id="nestedatt--task"></a>
### Nested Schema for `task`

Required:

- `type` (String) Task type, `Evaluation` or `Insight`.

Optional:

- `evaluation_id` (String) Identifier of the evaluation group. Required when `type` is `Evaluation`.
- `evaluation_run` (String) JSON-encoded evaluation run payload. Required when `type` is `Evaluation`.
- `insight` (String) JSON-encoded insight payload. Required when `type` is `Insight`.


<a id="nestedatt--trigger"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trigger`

Required:

- `type` (String) Trigger type. `Cron` fires on a cron expression. `Recurrence` fires on an interval and recurrence schedule. `OneTime` fires once at `trigger_at`.

Optional:

- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression defining the schedule frequency. Required when `type` is `Cron`.
- `days_of_month` (List of Number) Days of the month for a `Monthly` recurrence schedule.
- `days_of_week` (List of String) Days of the week for a `Weekly` recurrence schedule.
- `end_time` (String) ISO 8601 end time for `Cron` or `Recurrence` triggers.
- `hours` (List of Number) Hours of the day for a `Daily` recurrence schedule.
- `interval` (Number) Interval for a `Recurrence` trigger. Required when `type` is `Recurrence`.
- `recurrence_type` (String) Recurrence pattern for a `Recurrence` trigger: `Hourly`, `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`. Required when `type` is `Recurrence`.
- `start_time` (String) ISO 8601 start time for `Cron` or `Recurrence` triggers.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone for the trigger. Defaults to `UTC` when unset.
- `trigger_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp at which a `OneTime` trigger fires. Required when `type` is `OneTime`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Schedules are imported using the schedule ID.
terraform import foundry_schedule.nightly_evaluation nightly-evaluation
```
